DLC2313:3:t_3:40.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Ah, please keep that remark a secret from $$カイエン$$ and $$ＭＩＸ$$.」

DLC2313:3:t_3:41.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And with that, everyone... Until we meet again.」

DLC2313:4:t_000:0.en:
$$渓$$
「Special training, huh... Can that really change this gloomy atmosphere...?」

DLC2313:4:t_000:1.en:
$$號$$
「A strong will has the power to change everything. Without it, nothing will move forward.」

DLC2313:4:t_000:2.en:
$$凱$$
「$$アマタ$$'s all fired up, but what about that lot...?」

DLC2313:4:t_000:7.en:
$$赤木$$
「$$シンジ$$... First, watch $$アマタ$$ and the others.」

DLC2313:4:t_000:8.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Start by getting fired up, $$アマタ$$. You won't get anywhere like this.」

DLC2313:4:t_001:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Not enough! Is that all the fighting spirit you've got?!」

DLC2313:4:t_002:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Now we can finally start the training...」

DLC2313:4:t_003:1.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Don't just stand there in midair! Are those wings just for show?!」

DLC2313:4:t_004:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「You think you can shake me and $$ゲッター$$ off with moves like that?!」

DLC2313:4:t_006:0.en:
$$アマタ$$
「The Infinity Punch can't catch him!」

DLC2313:4:t_006:1.en:
$$隼人$$
「You're too slow, $$アクエリオン$$!」

DLC2313:4:t_007:1.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Switch with me, $$アマタ$$! If we're going up against $$真ゲッター２$$'s speed, we need $$スパーダ$$!」

DLC2313:4:t_007:2.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Got it! I'm counting on you, $$ゼシカ$$!」

DLC2313:4:t_009:0.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「So this is the world beyond the speed of sound...!」

DLC2313:4:t_009:1.en:
$$隼人$$
「You're barely dodging, but you'll never win if all you do is defend.」

DLC2313:4:t_009:2.en:
$$カイエン$$
「Switch with me, $$ゼシカ$$! We can't win by playing to the enemy's strengths!」

DLC2313:4:t_009:3.en:
$$カイエン$$
「We'll overwhelm him with $$ゲパルト$$'s firepower!」

DLC2313:4:t_011:1.en:
$$弁慶$$
「If you want a contest of firepower, I'll take you on!」

DLC2313:4:t_011:2.en:
$$カイエン$$
「Then let's do it! Multiplying Missiles!!」

DLC2313:4:t_012:1.en:
$$弁慶$$
「Don't start screaming over this much! There's plenty more coming!!」

DLC2313:4:t_013:0.en:
$$いぶき$$
「The $$ゲッター$$ team is incredible...」

DLC2313:4:t_013:1.en:
$$青山$$
「This has gone past special training and straight into brutal drilling.」

DLC2313:4:t_013:2.en:
$$シンジ$$
「Do they... really have to go that far...?」

DLC2313:4:t_013:3.en:
$$赤木$$
「But $$アマタ$$, $$カイエン$$, $$ゼシカ$$... Not one of the $$エレメント$$s has run away.」

DLC2313:4:t_013:4.en:
$$サザンカ$$
「Hang in there, $$カイエン$$!」

DLC2313:4:t_013:5.en:
$$モロイ$$
「You're our ace, aren't you?! Don't let an attack like that beat you!」

DLC2313:4:t_013:6.en:
$$アンディ$$
「Switch with me, $$カイエン$$! I'll avenge you!」

DLC2313:4:t_013:7.en:
$$カイエン$$
「Don't write me off! I haven't lost yet!」

DLC2313:4:t_013:9.en:
$$シュレード$$
「The music of my dear friend is still appassionato. There's no need to worry.」

DLC2313:4:t_013:10.en:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「Show us a man's pride, $$カイエン$$!」

DLC2313:4:t_013:12.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「$$カイエン$$! With everyone saying all that, you can't afford to collapse!」

DLC2313:4:t_013:13.en:
$$カイエン$$
「Yeah! I wasn't planning to!」

DLC2313:4:t_013:15.en:
$$赤木$$
「I won't ask what happened to you after that $$時空震動$$ at $$ＮＥＲＶ$$ headquarters. And I'm not going to toss out easy words like get over it.」

DLC2313:4:t_013:17.en:
$$赤木$$
「So, $$シンジ$$... Let's get moving together.」

DLC2313:4:t_013:19.en:
$$赤木$$
「It's the same with $$竜馬$$ and the others. If you work your body until your mind goes blank, you can at least move forward.」

DLC2313:4:t_013:20.en:
$$赤木$$
「That's enough for now. Let's just move forward a little.」

DLC2313:4:t_014:0.en:
$$アスカ$$
「The salaryman's right. Keep your body moving, and you don't have to think about anything else.」

DLC2313:4:t_014:1.en:
$$マリ$$
「Hmm... So you've finally reached an age where you can take that advice without arguing.」

DLC2313:4:t_014:3.en:
$$マリ$$
「I'll join you, Princess! I'm ready to throw caution to the wind, too!」

DLC2313:4:t_016:1.en:
$$赤木$$
「Don't worry about how you do it. Just move the way you feel.」

DLC2313:4:t_017:1.en:
$$マリ$$
「So she's not just a doll.」

DLC2313:4:t_017:3.en:
$$カヲル$$
「Aren't you going to join them, $$シンジ$$?」

review.context: Ryouma, Hayato and Benkei push Aquarion through flight, speed and firepower drills. Akagi invites the Eva pilots to exercise without demanding they overcome trauma immediately.
decisions: The physical training is deliberately severe but the Elements willingly persevere.
Shrade's appassionato is retained as his musical assessment of Cayenne's passion.
Mari's Four-Eyes with Connections nickname preserves Asuka's accusation about her privileged connections.
